name: LlamaIndex
description: Data framework for LLM apps with agent workflows and 300+ integrations.
descriptionZh: 面向 LLM 应用的数据框架，含 Agent 工作流与 300+ 集成。
keyFact: LlamaIndex is an MIT-licensed Python data framework for LLM applications that started as GPT Index in November 2022; its core is llama-index-core with 300+ integration packages, and the company's commercial focus has shifted to LlamaParse while the open-source framework continues to be maintained.
keyFactZh: LlamaIndex 是 MIT 许可的 Python LLM 数据框架，2022 年 11 月以 GPT Index 之名起步；其核心为 llama-index-core，附带 300+ 集成包，公司商业重心已转向 LlamaParse，开源框架仍在维护。
